# freesheet.app

> Free online spreadsheet. No login, no cloud, works in your browser.

freesheet.app is a free browser-based spreadsheet supporting formulas (SUM, AVERAGE, IF,
and 7 more), CSV import/export, cell formatting, and undo/redo. All data saved to
localStorage. No account required.

## Key facts

- 100% free, no login
- Works offline after first visit
- 10 built-in formulas
- 26 columns × 100 rows
- CSV import via file picker or drag-and-drop
- Data never leaves your device
